summary: Small 12x12 ground cab on McCarty Butte in the Fremont National Forest, built about 1939, staffed by a sentinel in 1943, gone by the 1960s.

facts.design: non-standard 12x12 wood ground cab on a rock foundation, with an Osborne #6 firefinder
facts.status_note: Gone by the 1960s per the register and firelookout.com; Forest Lookouts marks it removed; no source describes what remains

notes_for_editor: Record agency reads 'U.S.Forest Service' on the register page; normalised to 'U.S. Forest Service'. firelookout.com spells the town 'Chemault' (Chemult is the usual spelling); the story does not use it. The 1939 date is approximate per Forest Lookouts. Staffing after the 1943 appointment is unknown. The register lists a 1948 Curtis family photo (courtesy Ron Kemnow collection); no image URL was found, so no photo entry. No source describes the site now, and one web search was run and it added no usable page beyond the register and firelookout.com.
